alignment: Immediate-parent dot-bracket pair tree: terminal pairs have no child pair; eligible midpoint in inclusive [79.5,119.5]; choose nearest 99.5, ties smaller opening index. Zero-based positions.
offset: floor(119.5-selected_midpoint+0.5); fallback 20 if no eligible terminal pair; range 0..40
copy: Copy all original 13 channels into offset:offset+200 unchanged; channel 13 = 1 there; all other entries zero. Never crop or refold.
partners: int64 [B,240]; initialize self indices; occupied indices = original partner indices + offset; symmetric, unpaired and padded are self.
paired_mask: aligned_x[:,4]+aligned_x[:,5]; excludes all padding and unpaired bases
scales: Retain depth_after/100 and signed partner_offset/199, not /239.
mfe: Separate float32 [B,1]; training median imputation, training mean and population std after imputation, frozen schema-v3 statistics in preprocessing.json.
frozen_views: Original 13x200 features and unchanged nine-channel 100x100 pair_grid.py view.
execution: Per minibatch only; build_aligned_features accepts numpy or torch on original device. No persistent padded dataset/grid caches.
metadata: ID joins only; neither ID, species nor label enters alignment or features. Labels are numeric_label; no target transformation beyond float32 binary labels.
